missionPremise: legacy-design-tools PR #608 (merged 2026-09-04T14:10:29Z, 83fb2a1e) added a third rowIndex=2 electric companion-row slot to the utilityService parcel-record writer, alongside the existing water(0)/sewer(1) slots. hauska-map's frontend model of utilityServiceFact was still {water, sewer} only. Per dispatch instruction, verified the real current served shape first-hand (gh api against legacy-design-tools main, not assumed from this repo's own stale comments, which still read 'No electric slot exists -- never invent one' as of the PR #600 merge earlier the same day) before touching any code -- same discipline as this week's earlier water/sewer fix (PR #347).

finding.rootCause: fact-sheet-resolver.ts / atom-chain-to-facets.ts / baked-facets.ts / sheet-to-card-model.ts / packages/parcel-fact-sheet only modeled water+sewer; any parcel whose only populated companion row was electric rendered no utility information at all (silently incomplete card, not a crash or refusal).
finding.liveExposureAtDiscovery: Backend (LDT PR #608) had already shipped and was live in production; frontend had not yet been updated. Confirmed via a direct live probe (5 real Williamson County (48491) parcels, all electric-only: water=null, sewer=null, electric=AUSTIN ENERGY) that the unfixed frontend would have dropped this data.

summary: One-item fix, no sub-agents needed. utilityServiceFact remodeled to read water/sewer/electric (was water/sewer only), verified against the real legacy-design-tools PR #608 shape via gh api rather than assumed.
